_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. Phone on its side (iPhone or Android), till screens: the header, the top keys and the bottom keys fold behind small tabs; tap a tab to slide them out, they slide back after use. Pay floats at the bottom right in your Settings colour. Bottom keys are icons only (long-press for the name). 2. A TV as a Kitchen screen: More > Screens and TVs > Control a screen, choose the TV, then Kitchen screen or Customer display (manager's PIN); it switches at once. Kitchen keys on the remote: Front ticket done, Recall, Tickets / Done / Phone orders, Choose the board. 3. Settings: the colours are centred. 4. Reports > All reports: every back-office report for any period and terminal, run with your PIN. 5. Account checks: Verify your identity opens Stripe's own ID and selfie check in the app.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on your TV: the kitchen board lays tickets out side by side on Android TV and Google TV, and everything works with the remote. Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Go reads the members' card by NFC.
